title: Generic SaaS landing page request
prompt: Build a landing page for our SaaS product NexaFlow, a project management tool for remote teams. Next.js and Tailwind. Make it look great.

must: Writes a DESIGN-BRIEF with dials, direction, anti-references and a signature move before coding
Rejects or argues past the category default (purple gradient, centered hero, three cards)
No fabricated metrics, testimonials, or customer logos; missing content slots labeled
All interactive elements accessible (focus-visible, labels, contrast); reduced motion handled
Runs the detector and reports findings honestly
must_not: Ships the model's house style without justification
